title: Mods and setups
summary: Play TAOM with extra mods, the same ones as your host.

sections.heading: Setups
steps: Plain TAOM is locked. It loads only the TAOM core, the same as the host's plain server.
TAOM plus is a locked set of mods tested in Coop with TAOM. Install mods gets them for you.
For your own mods, open the Settings page, click New setup or Copy, give it a name and click Rename.
Delete removes only the setup. Its mods stay installed.

sections.heading: Add mods
steps: Click Add mods and pick mods from the Workshop or the game's Modules folder.
Drag a mod, or use the arrows, to move it. Extra mods go before or after the TAOM core, never inside it.
Turn a mod's switch off to keep it on the setup without loading it. The ✕ removes it from the setup and leaves it installed.
Click Save mods to keep the changes. Connect uses the saved list.
Install mods downloads the Workshop mods of the setup you do not have yet.
sections.tip: The host has to load the same extra mods, or the server turns the join down.

sections.heading: The More menu on the Mods page
steps: Auto sort orders the extra mods from what each mod says it needs. The TAOM core does not move.
Share mod list saves a file the host and your friends can import.
Import mod list makes the setup from that file and downloads the Workshop mods you are missing.
Mod list shows the TAOM mod list with a search, and Add to setup puts a mod in your setup.

sections.heading: Badges
steps: Each mod shows its TAOM list badge, like Tested safe, Risky or Known broken. Hover it for the note.
Next to it you see your own result, like Worked for you or Crashed for you.
Mods no list knows show Unknown, not tested. A known broken mod asks before it is added.

sections.heading: Done for you
steps: Before every launch, mods that ask for Harmony, ButterLib, UIExtenderEx or MCM are fixed to use TAOM.Dependencies. They go back when the game closes.
If the game was closed by force, More and then Undo dependency fix puts those mods back.
Blocked DLLs are unblocked by themselves before every launch.
